§6Catalytic Reformer§f

§aTurn mediocre fractions into premium products, reformate, liquid hydrogen, sulfuric acid.§f

The §bCatalytic Reformer§f is an optional late-game machine that upgrades petroleum products into more valuable ones. It chews through §e2,000 mB/s§f of fluid at §e400 kHE/s§f and needs a §bCatalytic Converter§f (Hard Plastic Bars + Cobalt Powder + Arsenic) to operate.

The headline recipe: §e1,000mB§f Naphtha → §e500mB§f Reformate + §e150mB§f Petroleum Gas + §e100mB§f Liquid Hydrogen. But check JEI, it also reformats Light Oil into Aromatic Hydrocarbons and Reformate Gas, and the big one: §e1,000mB§f Sour Gas → §e750mB§f Sulfuric Acid + §e100mB§f Petroleum Gas + §e150mB§f Liquid Hydrogen.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Factory): §e12×§f Cast Steel Plate, §e8×§f Copper Plate, §e8×§f Niobium Ingot, §e4×§f Cadmium Steel Ingot, §e3×§f Steel Shell, §e8×§f Steel Pipe, §e1×§f Motor, §e1×§f Versatile Circuit Board.

§ePS:§f Pairs beautifully with the §bHydrotreater§f. The reformer makes Liquid Hydrogen, the hydrotreater eats it, loop them together with a Vacuum Refinery for a closed petrochemical system.
